client-delivery.description: Project outcomes, client relationships, and delivery excellence.

criteria.text: Delivers measurable business outcomes for clients, tracked against agreed success metrics.
Builds and sustains trusted relationships with senior client stakeholders.
Sets the standard for delivery quality, proactively managing risk and communicating status.
Aligns delivery approach with client strategic priorities and long-term objectives.
Contributes to client account growth through excellence in delivery and relationship stewardship.

leadership.description: Team leadership, mentoring, influence, and culture.

criteria.text: Models inclusive leadership behaviors and creates psychological safety within teams.
Influences and aligns cross-functional teams and senior stakeholders toward shared goals.
Develops team members through structured coaching, mentoring, and stretch assignments.
Translates organizational strategy into clear team direction and measurable objectives.
Builds high-performing teams that consistently deliver results and retain top talent.

business-development.description: Pipeline contribution, proposals, and market presence.

criteria.text: Contributes to measurable pipeline growth through proactive opportunity identification and pursuit.
Engages prospective and existing clients to identify and qualify new business opportunities.
Leads or substantially contributes to proposal development and competitive positioning.
Pursues opportunities aligned with the firm's strategic priorities and growth areas.
Converts identified opportunities into won engagements and expanded client relationships.

firm-contribution.description: Internal initiatives, knowledge sharing, community, and operations.

criteria.text: Champions internal initiatives that strengthen firm culture, capability, or community.
Shares expertise broadly through thought leadership, publications, or internal enablement programs.
Drives measurable improvements in firm operations, processes, or employee experience.
Aligns internal contributions with firm strategic priorities and transformation goals.
Creates reusable assets, frameworks, or programs that provide lasting value to the firm.
